operation: Y[M,N] = X_FP32[M,K] * W_IQ2S[N,K]^T + bias_FP32[N]; FP32 output
scope: Production projection operations with actual unquantized FP32 activations; not complete model forward/training throughput.

timing.order: Round robin; reverse variant order on odd rounds
timing.gpuMetric: Sum of OpenCL kernel event durations, excluding device-to-device copies
timing.wallMetric: Host Stopwatch from projection allocation/dispatch through synchronization, excluding profile dictionary copies
timing.included: Each call packs activation and weights required by its route, including temporary allocation/pool reuse and device-to-device row chunk copies in host wall timing; input/bias/encoded weights and output remain resident
timing.excluded: Program compilation, initial input uploads, CPU references, output readback, model disk reads, source/file hashing

validation.outputGuards: Every validation poisons output and two trailing guards with NaN
validation.originalReference: Original inference GGUF BSLM with high/residual input packing; independent CPU double dot uses FP32-decoded IQ2 weights

activation.distribution: Deterministic uniform [-2,2), optional two ±100000 range-fallback values
